player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} ku JoJoJoin, imenechezwa pa bodo la 5x5 ndi ma celli anayiwa 0-24.
Pa zamu zako, weka alama yako pa celli yoyose iliyo wazi, e.g. '[12]'.
UNASHINDA kwa kupata alama zako nne mfululizo — ma celli manne mfululizo wima, mlalo, kapena diagonal.
Ndi Mchezaji {player_id} ndiwe '{symbol}'; mpinzani wako ndi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kutumiza kwa mpigo haukufuata mfumo wakutumiza.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ni selo ilo likugwira nchito yayi. Likwenera kuŵa pakati pa 0 na 24.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} wakaika alama yao ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
